matching_half_in_box: lichess-org-mobile is the client app for the same server; lila is the server half for lichess-org-mobile. Both are in the box.
inspiration: Puzzle Storm combo ladder: a combo meter with a short table of thresholds and a time bonus each time a threshold is crossed. A wrong move resets the combo and takes time off the clock (ui/storm/src/config.ts, ui/storm/src/ctrl.ts). Keep the table-as-data and the reset on error; change the reward to a stamina or guard refill for a fight.

Racer boost flag: a car gets a short 'boosting' state for one second after its score rises, which drives a visual kick without a timer object (ui/racer/src/boost.ts). Keep the one-second window; apply it to a combo or parry flash on the hero or creature.

Rating shown as an interval, not a point: the server displays rating minus and plus two deviations, and a player is only ranked when deviation is under a threshold (modules/rating/src/main/Glicko.scala). Keep the interval display for a hidden-stat readout; change the naming and the threshold.

Sound packs with a shared core cue set: the futuristic and robot folders both carry Berserk, Capture, Check, Checkmate and CountDown0-10, and each adds its own extras (public/sound/futuristic/, public/sound/robot/). Recreate the core-plus-extras layout for our own packs with new sounds; a theme then swaps the sound, not the code path.

Countdown ticks as numbered files (CountDown0 to CountDown10) in each pack, so a countdown needs no code change per theme (public/sound/futuristic/, public/sound/robot/). Keep the numbered-tick pattern; change the voice and timbre.

Pixel-grid piece set (public/piece/pixel) and letter-glyph set (public/piece/letter): silhouettes built from a grid or a single glyph still read at small size. Useful as a readability test at 375 wide, not as a look to copy.

Board thumbnail previews (public/images/board/ and lichess-org-mobile assets/board-thumbnails): a grid of small material previews in a picker. Keep the picker idea for arena surface skins; use our own materials and palettes.

briefs.label: Storm-style combo ladder with a stamina refill
briefs.why: A readable meter with four tiers; each tier gives a clear reward and a clear sound. It reads at 375 wide as a single bar with notches.
briefs.keep: threshold table as data; reward on crossing a threshold; reset on a miss
briefs.change: reward is a guard or stamina refill, not clock time; a miss costs guard, not time; tier colours come from our own ramp
briefs.ref: ui/storm/src/config.ts (combo levels); ui/lib/src/puz/combo.ts lines 37-47 (bonus on threshold)

briefs.label: Numbered countdown tick pack
briefs.why: A short countdown the player hears before a round or a timed finisher, built from numbered files so the count works in every theme.
briefs.keep: one file per second, same names in every pack, a distinct low-time cue
briefs.change: our own voice and timbre; the tick is a clay-metal or bone click, not the lila tone

briefs.label: Pixel-grid unit silhouette test
briefs.why: A unit built from a small grid still reads as one shape at phone size; the set is a good test for threat readability.
briefs.keep: single-colour silhouette with one accent; grid-aligned edges
briefs.change: our head and limb proportions; a two-tone palette; no chess shape language

briefs.label: Short 'just scored' flash
briefs.why: A one-second flag that turns on when a score rises and turns off on its own gives feedback without a stored timer.
briefs.keep: a per-entity timestamp that is checked against the current time
briefs.change: the flash is a parry or combo flare on the attacker, not a car boost
